subject: general
question: The speed of a train is 144 km/hr. The distance covered by the train in 12 seconds is:
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the train = 144 km/hr

Time = 12 seconds

**Formula Used:**

Speed (in m/s) = Speed (in km/hr) × (5/18)

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Speed (in m/s) = 144 × (5/18)

⇒ Speed (in m/s) = 40 m/s

⇒ Distance = 40 × 12

⇒ Distance = 480 m

**∴ The correct answer is 480 m.**
